name: rehoyo-platform
description: ReHoYo sender agent, regional desktop pet, and Cloudflare delivery Worker.

scripts.setup:all: npm --prefix sender-agent install && npm --prefix pet install && npm --prefix website-worker install
scripts.build:all: npm run build:sender && npm run build:pet && npm run build:web
scripts.test:all: npm run test:sender && npm run test:pet && npm run test:web
scripts.dist:all: npm run dist:sender && npm run dist:pet
